steps.name: auth_validate
steps.title: Validate the authentication change (spoke, headends, profiles)
steps.summary: spoke1: psk -> certificate on 2 tunnel(s) to central-headend, east-headend; central-headend keeps the certificate profile; east-headend keeps the certificate profile

steps.name: auth_intent
steps.title: Record the spoke's authentication in the intent
steps.summary: spoke1: ike_authentication = certificate in lab-intent.json (the lab default; the override is dropped)

steps.name: pki
steps.title: Certificates: enrol the routers with the lab CA (trustpoint, CA cert, router cert)
steps.summary: 5 router(s) hold a certificate from the lab CA; enrolled now: spoke1

steps.name: plan
steps.title: Terraform plan
steps.summary: Plan: 4 to add, 8 to change, 4 to destroy.

steps.name: apply
steps.title: Terraform apply + save config
steps.summary: 2 added, 2 changed, 1 destroyed.; 0 added, 6 changed, 0 destroyed.; 2 added, 0 changed, 3 destroyed.

steps.name: pki_verify
steps.title: Certificates: pre-shared keys off the routers, every tunnel re-authenticated with RSA
steps.summary: central-headend: 4/4 2 PSK, 2 RSA; east-headend: 3/3 1 PSK, 2 RSA; west-headend: 3/3 2 PSK, 1 RSA; spoke1: 2/2 2 RSA; spoke2: 2/2 2 PSK; spoke3: 3/3 3 PSK; spoke4: 3/3 3 RSA
